mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (sf.id)
,sc.id as sc_id, v.id as sc_video_id, sc.sub_id as sc_sub_id, sc.content_id, v.id as v_id, v.video_name as v_video_name, v.video_name_index as v_video_name_index, v.file_id as v_file_id, v.video_source as video_source, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.name_index as s_name_index, s.description as s_description, s.sub_img_id as s_sub_img_id
, COALESCE((select count(id) from gc_user_save_content where folder_id=sf.id and master_id=#{masterId}),0) as videoNum, (select gv.file_id from gc_user_save_content sc join pt_channel_content pcc on pcc.content_id = sc.content_id join gc_video gv on gv.id = pcc.content_id where sc.folder_id=sf.id and sc.master_id=#{masterId} order by sc.create_time asc limit 1) as firstVideoFileId, s.state as course_state, s.available_type as course_available_type from gc_user_save_folder sf left join gc_user_save_content sc on sc.folder_id = sf.id
AND (sc.user_id=#{userId})
AND (sc.user_id=#{userId} or not sf.is_private)
left join gc_video v on v.id = sc.content_id AND v.id IN (SELECT content_id FROM course_content) left join gc_subject s on s.id= v.origin_course_id left join sys_file fs on s.sub_img_id=fs.id left join sys_file f on v.file_id=f.id left join gc_user u on u.id = sf.user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id left join sys_file uf on info.avatar_file_id = uf.id where 1=1
AND sf.user_id=#{userId}
and sf.name like CONCAT('%',#{playListName},'%')
and (not sf.is_private or sf.user_id=#{userId}) and sf.master_id=#{masterId}
AND sf.id in
#{folderId}
AND sf.id not in
#{myFolderId}
order by sf.id DESC, sf.create_time DESC, sc.create_time DESC

SELECT playlist.name, playlist_content.file_id as sc_file_id, GREATEST(playlist.update_time, playlist_content.update_time) AS update_time, playlist_content.video_id as sc_video_id, playlist_content.content_id as content_id from gc_user_save_folder playlist LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content playlist_content on playlist.id=playlist_content.folder_id WHERE playlist.id = #{folderId} ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (playlist.update_time - playlist_content.update_time))) desc LIMIT 1

SELECT time_bucket, COUNT(playlist.id) AS value FROM gc_user_save_folder playlist RIGHT JOIN generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket ON playlist.create_time >= time_bucket AND playlist.master_id = #{masterId} AND playlist.create_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket

SELECT playlist.id, playlist.name, playlist.is_private, playlist.user_id, playlist.master_id, playlist.create_time, playlist.update_time, content.id as sc_id, content.content_id, content.create_time as sc_create_time, content.update_time as sc_update_time, playlist_follow.update_time as subscription_time, video.id as v_id, video.video_name as v_video_name
FROM gc_user_save_folder playlist JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = playlist.user_id JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file uf ON uf.id = info.avatar_file_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow ON playlist_follow.folder_id = playlist.id AND playlist_follow.user_id = #{portalUser.userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content content ON content.folder_id = playlist.id LEFT JOIN gc_video video ON video.id = content.content_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = video.file_id WHERE playlist.user_id = #{portalUser.userId} AND playlist.master_id = #{portalUser.masterId} ORDER BY playlist.update_time DESC;

SELECT playlist.id, playlist.name, playlist.is_private, playlist.user_id, playlist.master_id, playlist.create_time, playlist.update_time, content.id as sc_id, content.content_id, content.create_time as sc_create_time, content.update_time as sc_update_time, video.id as v_id, video.video_name as v_video_name, playlist_follow.update_time as subscription_time
FROM gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow JOIN gc_user_save_folder playlist ON playlist.id = playlist_follow.folder_id AND playlist.master_id = #{portalUser.masterId} AND playlist.is_private = false JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = playlist.user_id JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file uf ON uf.id = info.avatar_file_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content content ON content.folder_id = playlist.id LEFT JOIN gc_video video ON video.id = content.content_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = video.file_id WHERE playlist_follow.user_id = #{portalUser.userId} ORDER BY playlist.update_time;

SELECT playlist.id, playlist.name, playlist.is_private, playlist.user_id, playlist.master_id, playlist.create_time, playlist.update_time, content.id as sc_id, content.content_id, content.create_time as sc_create_time, content.update_time as sc_update_time, video.id as v_id, video.video_name as v_video_name, playlist_follow.update_time as subscription_time
FROM gc_user_save_folder playlist JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = playlist.user_id JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file uf ON uf.id = info.avatar_file_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow ON playlist_follow.folder_id = playlist.id AND playlist_follow.user_id = #{portalUser.userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content content ON content.folder_id = playlist.id LEFT JOIN gc_video video ON video.id = content.content_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = video.file_id WHERE playlist_follow.id IS NULL AND playlist.master_id = #{portalUser.masterId} AND playlist.is_private = false AND playlist.user_id != #{portalUser.userId} AND (playlist.update_time < #{cursor.updateTime} OR (playlist.update_time = #{cursor.updateTime} AND playlist.id < #{cursor.id})) ORDER BY playlist.update_time DESC, playlist.id DESC;

SELECT playlist.id, playlist.name, playlist.is_private, playlist.user_id, playlist.master_id, playlist.create_time, playlist.update_time, content.id as sc_id, content.content_id, content.create_time as sc_create_time, content.update_time as sc_update_time, video.id as v_id, video.video_name as v_video_name, playlist_follow.update_time as subscription_time
FROM gc_user_save_folder playlist JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = playlist.user_id JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file uf ON uf.id = info.avatar_file_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow ON playlist_follow.folder_id = playlist.id AND playlist_follow.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content content ON content.folder_id = playlist.id LEFT JOIN gc_video video ON video.id = content.content_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = video.file_id WHERE playlist_follow.id IS NULL AND playlist.master_id = #{masterId} AND playlist.is_private = false AND playlist.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY playlist.update_time DESC, playlist.id DESC;

SELECT playlist.id, playlist.name, playlist.is_private, playlist.user_id, playlist.master_id, playlist.create_time, playlist.update_time, content.id as sc_id, content.content_id, content.create_time as sc_create_time, content.update_time as sc_update_time, video.id as v_id, video.video_name as v_video_name, playlist_follow.update_time as subscription_time, course.state as course_state, course.available_type as course_available_type, channel.visible_flag as channel_visible_flag
FROM gc_user_save_folder playlist JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = playlist.user_id JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file uf ON uf.id = info.avatar_file_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow ON playlist_follow.folder_id = playlist.id AND playlist_follow.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_content content ON content.folder_id = playlist.id LEFT JOIN gc_video video ON video.id = content.content_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = video.file_id LEFT JOIN pt_channel channel ON video.origin_channel_id = channel.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject course ON video.origin_course_id = course.id WHERE playlist.master_id = #{masterId} AND (playlist.is_private = false OR playlist.user_id = #{userId}) AND playlist.name ilike concat('%', #{searchName}, '%')
